title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers: Prior-Use Months on Extension
content:
The extension term of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers counts prior-use months, which depend on the redemption entries the credit carries.

**The rule.** The prior-use months of an extension are 2 months when the credit carries at least 3 redemption entries, 1 month when it carries at least one but fewer than 3, and none when it carries no redemption entry.

## Questions on the rule

**Which entries are counted?**
The redemption entries on this credit's own value history.

**What do exactly 3 entries give?**
2 months. The figure of 3 counts as reached.

**What do 2 entries give?**
1 month, because 2 is at least one but fewer than 3.

## Count and months

| Redemption entries on the credit | Prior-use months |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2 |
| 2 | 1 |
| 1 | 1 |
| none | none |
